g.text: # a governed context API: plan, compact, deny protected edits, recall, evaluate
timing: allow — phase 'subtask_complete' is a natural boundary; compaction permitted
plan: [{'start': '3', 'end': '14'}] | notes: ['executing in one turn invalidates the KV prefix from eve…
try to archive the system prompt → denied protected_context
recall hint: 10 Ledger note: entity ALPHA-7 reported receipts for FY2019 of 1,259 mill
recalled: Ledger note: entity ALPHA-7 reported receipts for FY2019 of 1,259 million USD. The consoli
# CTXBench: harness vs unrestricted vs guided vs adaptive (mode | CIS | accuracy | critical)
$ ctxbudgeter bench -a reckless -n 1 --families research,coding --budgets 4000 -o report.json --traces t
# graduated autonomy: promote / hold / demote from benchmark evidence
# learn a per-model policy from the agent's own decision traces
• unsafe → stricter edit rate and recency rules; autonomy capped at L2 until re-certified
• tightened policy → governed fallback compaction enabled as the safe path
# turn decisions into SFT, DPO and reward datasets
$ ctxbudgeter train-export traces.jsonl -o datasets > /dev/null && wc -l datasets/*.jsonl
# install the portable context-management skill (Claude Code or any SKILL.md loader)
$ ctxbudgeter skill export ./skills && find skills -type f | sort
# the same governed API for any MCP client
context_inspect context_budget context_diagnose context_plan context_compact context_pin
